functional_goal: Qualify, deploy, roll back, soak, measure, and finally retire the Python Re-CTM production runtime without dual authority, data loss, or an unbounded performance claim.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Invoking the pinned cargo executable without the pinned toolchain bin on PATH could not find the cargo-fmt subcommand.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Used the existing exact project rustup toolchain environment rather than weakening formatting or lint gates.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The initial process sampler split /proc/*/stat on spaces; process names containing spaces caused the whole resource sample to be discarded and RSS was falsely recorded as zero.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Rejected the evidence, replaced child discovery with /proc/<pid>/task/<pid>/children, added real RSS/thread/fd sampling, and reran all seven Python and Rust repetitions.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first short soak mixed normal allocator warm-up with steady-state memory growth, making the whole-run RSS slope too close to the threshold to support a leak conclusion.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Extended the soak to sixty seconds, measured a tail window after fifteen seconds, added absolute RSS/tail-growth/fd/thread/child limits, and reran it.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first candidate report attempted to hash a temporary rollback wheel after its temporary directory had already been removed.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Captured wheel SHA-256 and size while the artifact existed and retained only non-sensitive immutable facts in the candidate report.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Two full MTM-007 target reruns observed a public tunnel URL but the external metadata endpoint was transiently unavailable while all local and owned-child checks passed.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Kept the same acceptance condition, confirmed the exact standalone public-metadata path, and reran the complete target suite until the real edge metadata and owned cleanup both passed.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first live restart inherited no operator password for three sessions, so the generated OAuth key was written into owner-only background logs even though public evidence remained redacted.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Rejected the first live evidence, atomically rolled back to Python, rebuilt equivalent Python sessions, removed the first deployment root, generated replacement keys into dedicated mode-0600 files, restarted every session with RE_CTM_OAUTH_PASSWORD set, and reran the complete live cutover/rollback/recutover. The final logs contain only the configured-externally marker.

evidence: Rust 0.3.0 workspace formatting, Clippy with warnings denied, Rust tests, governance tests, and graph validators pass.
The deployment manager has atomic-selector, rollback, recutover, mode, and fail-closed identity tests.
All MTM-002 through MTM-007 frozen differentials remain exact.
The release-info contract identifies re-ctm 0.3.0, Rust implementation, no Python runtime, 24 public tools, 11 hidden aliases, state schema 2 and workflow protocol 2.
The existing eighteen-checkpoint full-composition Python-Rust differential still has zero mismatches.
Candidate cutover tests use disposable command links, state roots, databases and workspaces.
The command link selects exactly one release atomically and manifests are owner-only.
Retirement fails unless Rust is active, the rollback wheel hash matches, and no Python-tool-root process remains.
All MTM-003 through MTM-007 real target reports are fresh after the Rust 0.3.0 release changes.
A real Re-CTM 0.3.0 wheel was built, restored with uv, executed, and used in both temporary and live rollback drills.

Four live Python serve/TUI sessions and their owned descendants stopped cleanly, the user command selected Rust, live rollback selected Python, recutover selected Rust, and all four sessions restarted on the exact recorded Rust release.
Generated operator keys are owner-only secret files and no raw key is present in the final background logs or evidence.
The sixty-second Rust soak completed 167122 requests with zero errors and 29 stateful start/cancel cycles.
Tail RSS growth was 860 KiB, fd/thread growth was zero, no child process remained, and shutdown was graceful.
Seven repetitions per runtime and 5600 measured requests per runtime used the same authenticated local OAuth/MCP workload with eight clients.
Observed Rust/Python median throughput ratio was 2.275978; p95 latency ratio 0.526035; peak RSS ratio 0.668591.
Conservative bootstrap ratios were 2.14589 throughput, 0.54653 p95 latency, and 0.67161 RSS, all beyond predefined thresholds.
A6.claim_scope: Authenticated loopback OAuth/MCP ping, tools/list, server_info, read_file, and check_exec_environment under eight concurrent clients only.
